product.olivetti-m4-46.summary: The 50 MHz DX2 M4 in the MicroTower chassis.
product.olivetti-m4-46.history: The M4 Modulo range targeted professionals and sat between the personal-use PCS and the higher-performance M6 Suprema. The guide identifies T.1 boards made in Singapore and Scarmagno.
product.olivetti-m4-46.warning: Partial T.1 motherboard emulation with the Olivetti 2.06 service BIOS.
product.olivetti-m4-46.architecture: Memory can grow without replacing the base RAM. The board has 4 MB soldered down, one SIMM socket and CL-GD5428 graphics. The service guide lists 85, 170 and 240 MB IDE disks in the shared family list.
product.olivetti-m4-46.verified: BluMach tested POST, floppy boot and VGA mode 13h with 4 MB of RAM and 512 KiB of video memory. The original Setup 1.04 saved CMOS in Standard mode. MS-DOS 5.00 booted from IDE after a power cycle with 85, 170 and 240 MB disks.
product.olivetti-m4-46.limitations: The 83C206Q and keyboard controller use compatible models. The factory BIOS, exact disk geometries and other board revisions remain unconfirmed.
product.olivetti-m4-46.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 2
product.olivetti-m4-46.firmware: The family service package contains the Olivetti 2.06 BIOS and OVC 1.09 video firmware. The factory revision for this model remains unconfirmed.
product.olivetti-m4-46.creation.note: Place the 128 KiB service ROM at roms/machines/olivetti_m4_trota/EPROM.ROM.
The disk is created blank with a representative geometry. Use Olivetti Setup in Standard mode and install DOS from floppy.
product.olivetti-m4-46.source-bios: Olivetti M4-4x/M4-6x service package, trota206.zip, 128 KiB EPROM.ROM.
